service.name: Daytime live music and sound baths
service.serviceType: Live music and sound baths during the day for senior living communities, memorial services, brunches, workplaces, yoga studios, farmers markets, libraries and rec centers
service.description: Solo musicians, duos and a sound bath for daytime bookings across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor: a jazz duo for senior living and memory care, a guitarist or pianist for a funeral or memorial service, live music for Sunday brunch, a daytime sound bath for studios, offices, senior centers and schools, and musicians for farmers markets, libraries and rec center programs, on one contract with sound included.

faqs.q: Do you book live music during the day, on weekdays?
faqs.a: Yes. A weekday afternoon at a senior living community, a lunchtime sound bath at an office, a weekday morning memorial service and a Saturday farmers market are all bookings we take, and they're usually a solo or a duo. Send the date and the venue and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for that date.

Solo and duo, almost always. One musician with a guitar or a piano, or upright bass and guitar, plays at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest seat and sets up in a corner without a stage. A trio plays a brunch or a community evening where the space is bigger, and the sound bath is one facilitator.

faqs.q: Can we book the same act every month?
faqs.a: Yes. A standing date, monthly or every other week, runs on one contract with one personal contact for the whole run. What the contract names is the configuration and the repertoire, so a community that books the jazz duo gets upright bass and guitar playing the standards on every visit, and a named act, Tejas Singh or Firstwater, is the same act on every date.

faqs.q: Do you provide the vendor paperwork a facility or a city needs?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming your venue as additional insured, a W-9 and one itemised invoice come in the same email as the contract, which is usually what a business office needs to set up a vendor before the first date.

faqs.q: Do you play outdoors, at a market or in a park?
faqs.a: Yes, on three conditions written down before the day: a covered, level and dry performance area, power run to it or a battery-powered system agreed in advance, and a move-indoors or rain call agreed with the coordinator. Colorado weather changes fast, and instruments and electronics stop behaving in the wet.

faqs.q: How much does daytime live music cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the size, the length and the date, and we publish no prices of our own. What live music costs in this market, with the source for each figure, is on the pricing page, and each date is priced as its own job. Send the date and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price.
